faqs.a:
The city council may appoint as many relief judges as is determined at the sole discretion
               of the city council to substitute for the presiding or associate judge from time-to-time.
               Relief judges shall be residents of the city and shall be compensated pursuant to
               an employment agreement, be supervised by the presiding judge on day-to-day opera
               tions of the municipal court and shall report to the city council as directed from
               time-to-time.
(Code 1981, § 18-43; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
